summary: podYaml gained the aac-tools template with its test and reference-page rows (JenkinsPipelineUtils c4de566). Twelve Pipeline types pages now show a complete reference Jenkinsfile for each of T1–T12, including the DockerImages generator, Intercom's written-out stages and AaC/Architecture's computed-trigger recipes; all 14 example files pass the controller's full declarative linter as published (ab605b7). kc project test and kc project lint are green.
